_comment: Configuration of runtime/close/close.py (contract: runtime/close/README.md). Save it as <kb-root>/.engine-kit/close.json and version it with the knowledge base. Fictional example: the Acme Orders knowledge base, its application and test-suite working copies beside it, a retired file share (drive letter and UNC name), a retired tool folder and a retired wiki. Keys starting with _ are notes. Every key is optional: a missing key keeps its default.
_mode: warn (EK#6) until a numbered project decision turns the door blocking: then "mode": "strict" and "decision": "WS#12"
_level: the case's adoption level (docs/ADOPTION-LEVELS.md): 1, 2 or 3, default 3 (this base, which keeps a memory index). At 2 the memory index and validate-registry.ps1 are left out and the checklist's level-3 item (card decision) is not printed; at 1 the test gate too, and the unversioned files are one note (they wait for the owner's release word). --level wins. Not checks.<name>.level, which is the level of a finding.
_svnClientIgnored: svn only (EK#17): true lists, as unversioned, the files that only the svn client's global-ignores hides, so the scope and unversioned checks see them; the repository's svn:ignore / svn:global-ignores still apply. A workingCopies entry may set its own "svnClientIgnored".

scope._frozen: frozen sources: never edited, never marked (skills/scope-census). The list replaces the default (the two frozen-draft names): keep them when adding the case's own - here the owner's written answers, kept as received, and an archive of official sources. The owner's original of a frozen draft needs no entry while it is byte-identical to its copy.

retired._locations: write each location once; its other spellings (forward slashes, escaped backslashes, /r/..., file URLs) are derived. A drive letter and a UNC name of the same share are two spellings: list both.

locations.why: the old knowledge share, frozen on 2026-03-01

memory._db: solo profile: the runtime area, outside the versioned base (EK#5) - a folder beside the base, as here, or a folder inside it that version control ignores, e.g. ".runtime/memory-index.db" (EK#27; then no checks.unversioned.ignore entry is needed)

_checklist: an item is a text (every level) or {"text": ..., "level": n} (printed from level n on)

checklist.text: Episodic log written, claims with evidence (revision, work item, card id)
Card decision stated for every fact >= 0.8: new card / strengthened card / no card (why)

checklist: Owning index or registry row updated; root rules only if the workspace state changed
Nothing obsolete left without a SUPERSEDED mark

checklist.text: Closing record written in TICKETS/<ID>/CLOSE.md; the tracker fields are the developer's to paste
Every new file under version control; fix and tests prepared as two commits, the fix first

checklist: Commit, push and tracker state are the human's, after the release word
